acceptanceCriteria: An independent reviewer in a fresh clone of main can run `corvint-tasks receipt audit` and obtain the same headSeq and projectionAgreement as the primary checkout, or the documented protocol states that audits are primary-checkout-only and names what a reviewer verifies instead.
body: Filed on 2026-09-23 from the independent review of PR #101 (store-only completions). In a fresh clone at 6717629, `corvint-tasks init` on main followed by `receipt audit` returns REFUSED INTENT_DIVERGED with headSeq 1, because the journal under `.git/taskman` is local and `help` lists `import` among the omitted commands; the reviewer rebuilt corvint-tasks from beamfall/corvint-tasks@5117b92 with the same result. The reviewer could verify ticket records and evidence digests from the committed files but not the journal-level audit that the corvint-tasks skill requires before any mutation.
title: corvint-tasks: a fresh clone cannot run `receipt audit` against the committed `.taskman/` store (`import` unimplemented, INTENT_DIVERGED after init)
